e.title: reliability-harness：先弄清智能体的可靠性在哪里终止，再扩大它的职责
e.title_en: reliability-harness: understand where an agent’s reliability ends before expanding its responsibilities
e.summary: 一个面向企业级智能体的可靠性评测工具：通过重复试验、提交证据与「范围扩张失效分析」定位智能体从哪一步开始不可靠；README 单设「什么算通过」「证据尚不能确立什么」两节，并列出必须提交的材料清单
e.summary_en: A reliability evaluation tool for enterprise agents: repeated trials, submission evidence and scope-expansion failure analysis locate the point from which an agent stops being reliable; the README carries separate sections on what counts as passing and what the evidence cannot establish yet, plus a list of required submission documents
e.summary_hk: 一個面向企業級智能體的可靠性評測工具：通過重複試驗、提交證據與「範圍擴張失效分析」定位智能體從哪一步開始不可靠；README 單設「什麼算通過」「證據尚不能確立什麼」兩節，並列出必須提交的材料清單
e.body:
**reliability-harness** 是一个**面向企业级智能体的可靠性评测工具**（仓库 `Reddytheer/reliability-harness`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★0、fork 0、主语言 Python、仓库体量 157 KB、创建于 2026-09-08、最后推送 2026-09-08**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**其 topics 逐字实测为 agent-reliability、ai-agents、enterprise-ai、insurance、llm-evaluation、product-management、python、streamlit**。本条目属于本轮主题**「把不可信之处写在明面上」**——**它的做法是把「证据尚不能确立什么」写成独立一节**。

可核实信息（**均实测**）：**仓库描述逐字为**：**「Evaluate where an enterprise agent stops being reliable: repeated trials, submission evidence, and scope-expansion failure analysis.」**——**即「评估一个企业级智能体**在哪里开始不可靠**：重复试验、提交证据、以及**范围扩张失效分析**」**。**README 逐字（11,954 字节）**：**顶部含 CI 检查徽章、MIT 许可徽章与贡献指南链接**；⭐⭐ **正文首句逐字**：**「Before expanding an agent’s responsibilities, understand where its reliability ends.」**——**「在扩大一个智能体的职责之前，先弄清它的可靠性在哪里终止。」**；**其后作者以第一人称自述**：**「In my experience building a product from the first customer problem thro[ugh]…」**——**即作者自述其经验来自从第一个客户问题开始把产品做起来的过程**（**引文在实测处以截断，词条内即止**）。⭐ **章节结构逐字实测**：**What this product does / Current build status / Open the evidence review / ⭐Required submission documents / ⭐What counts as passing / ⭐What the evidence cannot establish yet / Relationship to autonomy-ladder / Live evaluation and cost controls / Research that shaped the approach / Repository map**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 「Before expanding an agent’s responsibilities, understand where its reliability ends」是本条目最有价值的一句，也是一个很硬的方法论立场**——**它把问题的提法从「这个智能体行不行」改成「**它从哪一步开始不行**」**；**这不是修辞：**「行不行」是一个二值评价，而「从哪里开始不行」是一个可测量、可画边界的问题****；**对做模型验证、AI 治理或智能体上线的学生，这条提法直接可用**（**可与池内 [[phi-boundary-gate]] 的边界门控、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insqabench]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 并读——**那几条提供基准与门控，本条提供的是**边界定位这一动作本身****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「What the evidence cannot establish yet（证据尚不能确立什么）」单设一节，是第 319–321 轮同一条纪律的第四次出现**——**「What counts as passing（什么算通过）」与「What the evidence cannot establish yet」**并置**，**等于同时给出**验收标准**与**该标准的射程****；**⚠️ 本次**未读这两节正文**，故**不转述其具体通过标准与未确立事项的内容****（**这一点对本条目的价值影响很大，见下方标注**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「Required submission documents（必须提交的材料清单）」单独成节，说明这是一套**有交付物要求的评测流程**，而不是一个只跑分的脚本**——**「提交证据（submission evidence）」被写进仓库描述，意味着评测产出的是**可留存、可复核的证据包****；**这与本站「每条都标注核实层级」同源，也与第 319 轮 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「提交证据 + 托管检查」相接**（**未读该节，故不转述材料清单内容**）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「scope-expansion failure analysis（范围扩张失效分析）」是一个值得单独记的概念**——**它关心的不是智能体在**给定任务**上表现如何，而是**当你扩大它的职责范围时，哪一类失效开始出现****；**这正对应现实中的部署风险：**试点表现良好 → 扩大范围 → 失效**；**可与池内 [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[insurance-mlops]]、[[agentbench]] 并读**（**未读其方法，故不转述如何度量范围扩张失效**）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Relationship to autonomy-ladder（与自主性阶梯的关系）」一节说明它把结果挂在一个**分级授权**框架上**——**即评测的产出用于决定该给智能体多大的自主权**；**对做 AI 治理的学生，这是一个把「评测」与「授权」连起来的做法**（**本次未读该节，故不转述其阶梯分级**）。**⑥ ⭐ 「Live evaluation and cost controls（实况评测与成本控制）」说明评测在真实调用中产生成本并被计量**——**这是一条常被忽略但很现实的约束**（**可与 [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]] 并读**）。**⑦ ⭐ 「Research that shaped the approach」列出来源研究**——**把方法来源写明**。**⑧ ⭐ 仓库含 CI 徽章与 CONTRIBUTING.md**，**说明其工程规范程度高于同尺度项目**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics 八项、仓库描述与 README 的标题、首句、作者自述段与**完整章节结构（十节标题）****，⭐⭐ **但**未读 README 任何一个章节的正文**（**含 What counts as passing、What the evidence cannot establish yet、Required submission documents、Relationship to autonomy-ladder、Live evaluation and cost controls、Research that shaped the approach 全部未读正文**），**未克隆、未运行、未打开任何评测结果或提交证据示例**，因此**不能转述其通过标准、未确立事项、材料清单、评测方法、评测数值或自主性阶梯分级**；**② ⭐⭐ 本条目**最关键的未核实项正是它最核心的两个卖点**——**「什么算通过」与「证据尚不能确立什么」两节本次只读到标题**，**故词条内**不转述**其内容**；**这两节是否真的如标题所示那样交代清楚，本次未能判断**（**这一点必须让读者知道：本条目主张的是「它设了这两节」，不是「它把这两件事说清楚了」**）；**③ ⭐ 「范围扩张失效分析」「重复试验」「提交证据」均为**仓库描述自述**，**本次未独立检验其方法有效性**；**④ ⭐ 作者以第一人称写「In my experience…」**，**属**个人经验陈述**而非研究结论**——**本词条据此**不主张**其方法经过验证**；**⑤ 该仓库 topics 含 `insurance`，**但其是否面向保险场景、以及其评测对象是否为保险业务智能体本次未核实**（**本词条**不主张**其为保险专用工具**）；**⑥ ⭐ 「Research that shaped the approach」提示其有来源研究，**但本次未读该节，故不转述其引用了什么研究**；**⑦ 该仓库创建与推送同为 2026-09-08、★0、fork 0**，**说明其极新且关注度极低**，**不主张其成熟度或已被采用**；**⑧ 评测「企业级智能体」通常需要接入真实系统或数据**，**其对企业数据的处理方式、隐私与合规影响本次未评估**；**⑨ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/Reddytheer/reliability-harness` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 11,954 字节；本次逐字读取其标题、首句、作者自述段与十节章节标题，**未读任何章节正文**）；**未克隆、未运行、未打开任何评测结果**。
e.body_en:
**reliability-harness** is **a reliability evaluation tool for enterprise agents** (repository `Reddytheer/reliability-harness`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language, a 157 KB repository, created 2026-09-08 and last pushed 2026-09-08** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **its topics measurably read agent-reliability, ai-agents, enterprise-ai, insurance, llm-evaluation, product-management, python and streamlit**. It belongs to this round’s theme of writing the untrustworthy parts on the face of the work — **its method is a dedicated section on what the evidence cannot establish yet**.

Verifiable details (**all measured**): **the repository description reads verbatim**: **"Evaluate where an enterprise agent stops being reliable: repeated trials, submission evidence, and scope-expansion failure analysis."** **The README (11,954 bytes) reads verbatim**: it **opens with a CI checks badge, an MIT licence badge and a contributing link**; ⭐⭐ **the first line of the body reads verbatim**: **"Before expanding an agent’s responsibilities, understand where its reliability ends."**; **the author then writes in the first person**: **"In my experience building a product from the first customer problem thro[ugh]…"** — **that is, the author grounds the work in experience building a product from the first customer problem** (**the quotation truncates at the measured point and the entry quotes no further**). ⭐ **The section headings read verbatim**: **What this product does / Current build status / Open the evidence review / ⭐ Required submission documents / ⭐ What counts as passing / ⭐ What the evidence cannot establish yet / Relationship to autonomy-ladder / Live evaluation and cost controls / Research that shaped the approach / Repository map**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ "Before expanding an agent’s responsibilities, understand where its reliability ends" is the entry’s most valuable sentence and a hard methodological stance** — **it reframes the question from "can this agent do the job" to "at which step does it stop being able to"**; **this is not rhetoric: "can it" is a binary judgement, whereas "where does it stop" is a measurable, boundaryable question**; **for students doing model validation, AI governance or agent deployment, the framing is directly reusable** (**readable with the boundary gating of [[phi-boundary-gate]], [[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]], [[insqabench]] and [[actuarial-benchmarks]] — those supply benchmarks and gates, whereas this supplies the act of locating the boundary itself**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ A dedicated section on "What the evidence cannot establish yet" is the fourth appearance of the same discipline across rounds 319-321** — **placing "What counts as passing" beside "What the evidence cannot establish yet" gives both an acceptance standard and that standard’s reach**; **⚠️ neither section body was read, so their contents are not restated** (**which materially limits this entry — see below**). **③ ⭐⭐ "Required submission documents" as its own section shows this is an evaluation process with deliverable requirements rather than a scoring script** — **"submission evidence" in the description means the output is an retainable, re-checkable evidence pack**; **the same instinct as this site’s tiered verification and round 319’s [[powmcp-skills]] with its submission evidence and hosted checks** (**that section was not read, so no checklist content is restated**). **④ ⭐⭐ "Scope-expansion failure analysis" is a concept worth noting separately** — **it is not about how an agent performs on a given task but about which class of failure appears when you widen its responsibilities**; **exactly the real deployment risk: good in a pilot, scope widened, then failure**; **readable with [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]], [[insurance-monitoring]], [[insurance-mlops]] and [[agentbench]]** (**its method was not read, so how scope-expansion failure is measured is not restated**). **⑤ ⭐ "Relationship to autonomy-ladder" shows the results hang on a graded-authorisation framework** — **the evaluation output feeds a decision about how much autonomy to grant**; **for students of AI governance, a way of joining evaluation to authorisation** (**not read, so the ladder grading is not restated**). **⑥ ⭐ "Live evaluation and cost controls" shows evaluation runs against real calls with metered cost** — **an easily overlooked but very real constraint** (**readable with [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]**). **⑦ ⭐ "Research that shaped the approach" lists its sources** — **stating where the method came from**. **⑧ ⭐ The repository carries a CI badge and a CONTRIBUTING.md**, **indicating more engineering discipline than most projects of this size**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata, eight topics, the repository description, and the README’s title, first line, author statement and complete section structure (ten headings)**, ⭐⭐ **but read no section body at all** (**including What counts as passing, What the evidence cannot establish yet, Required submission documents, Relationship to autonomy-ladder, Live evaluation and cost controls and Research that shaped the approach**), **cloned nothing, ran nothing, and opened no evaluation result or submission-evidence example**, so **its pass criteria, unestablished items, document checklist, evaluation method, evaluation figures and autonomy-ladder grading cannot be restated**; **② ⭐⭐ The entry’s most important unverified item is precisely its core selling point** — **the two sections on what counts as passing and what the evidence cannot establish yet were read only as headings**, **so their content is not restated**; **whether those sections really do what their titles promise could not be judged** (**readers must know this: the entry claims the sections exist, not that the project explains those two things well**); **③ ⭐ "Scope-expansion failure analysis", "repeated trials" and "submission evidence" are repository-description self-reports**, **and their methodological effectiveness was not independently tested**; **④ ⭐ The author writes in the first person, "In my experience…"** — **a personal experience statement rather than a research finding** — **so the entry does not claim the method is validated**; **⑤ The topics include `insurance`, but whether the tool targets insurance scenarios, and whether the evaluated agents are insurance agents, were not verified** (**the entry does not claim it is insurance-specific**); **⑥ ⭐ "Research that shaped the approach" implies source research, but that section was not read, so what it cites is not restated**; **⑦ The repository was created and pushed on the same day, 2026-09-08, with ★0 and 0 forks**, **so it is extremely new with very low attention**, **and no maturity or adoption is claimed**; **⑧ Evaluating enterprise agents usually requires access to real systems or data**, **and its handling of enterprise data, privacy and compliance implications were not assessed**; **⑨ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/Reddytheer/reliability-harness` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 11,954-byte README; only the title, first line, author statement and ten section headings were read verbatim, **no section body**); **nothing cloned or run, no evaluation result opened**.
e.body_hk:
**reliability-harness** 是一個**面向企業級智能體的可靠性評測工具**（倉庫 `Reddytheer/reliability-harness`），**MIT 許可，實測 ★0、fork 0、主語言 Python、體量 157 KB、創建於 2026-09-08、最後推送 2026-09-08**；**topics 逐字實測為 agent-reliability、ai-agents、enterprise-ai、insurance、llm-evaluation、product-management、python、streamlit**。本條目屬本輪主題**「把不可信之處寫在明面上」**——**它的做法是把「證據尚不能確立什麼」寫成獨立一節**。

可核實資訊（**均實測**）：**倉庫描述逐字**：**「Evaluate where an enterprise agent stops being reliable: repeated trials, submission evidence, and scope-expansion failure analysis.」**——**即「評估一個企業級智能體**在哪裡開始不可靠**：重複試驗、提交證據、以及**範圍擴張失效分析**」**。**README 逐字（11,954 位元組）**：**頂部含 CI 檢查徽章、MIT 許可徽章與貢獻指南連結**；⭐⭐ **正文首句逐字**：**「Before expanding an agent’s responsibilities, understand where its reliability ends.」**——**「在擴大一個智能體的職責之前，先弄清它的可靠性在哪裡終止。」**；**其後作者以第一人稱自述**：**「In my experience building a product from the first customer problem thro…」**（**引文在實測處截斷，詞條內即止**）。⭐ **章節結構逐字實測（十節）**：**What this product does / Current build status / Open the evidence review / ⭐Required submission documents / ⭐What counts as passing / ⭐What the evidence cannot establish yet / Relationship to autonomy-ladder / Live evaluation and cost controls / Research that shaped the approach / Repository map**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ 首句是本條目最有價值的一句，也是一個很硬的方法論立場**——**它把問題的提法從「這個智能體行不行」改成「**它從哪一步開始不行**」**；**「行不行」是二值評價，而「從哪裡開始不行」是可測量、可畫邊界的問題****（可與 [[phi-boundary-gate]]、[[insurance-ai-reliability-benchmark]]、[[insqabench]]、[[actuarial-benchmarks]] 並讀——**那幾條提供基準與門控，本條提供的是**邊界定位這一動作本身****）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ 「What the evidence cannot establish yet」單設一節，是第 319–321 輪同一條紀律的第四次出現**——**與「What counts as passing」**並置**，等於同時給出**驗收標準**與**該標準的射程****；**⚠️ 本次**未讀這兩節正文****（**見下方標注**）。**③ ⭐⭐ 「Required submission documents」單獨成節，說明這是**有交付物要求的評測流程**（與第 319 輪 [[powmcp-skills]] 的「提交證據＋託管檢查」相接）。**④ ⭐⭐ 「scope-expansion failure analysis」是一個值得單獨記的概念**——**它關心的不是智能體在**給定任務**上表現如何，而是**當你擴大它的職責範圍時，哪一類失效開始出現****；**對應現實部署風險：**試點良好 → 擴大範圍 → 失效****（可與 [[continuous-monitoring-ai-risk]]、[[insurance-monitoring]]、[[insurance-mlops]]、[[agentbench]] 並讀）。**⑤ ⭐ 「Relationship to autonomy-ladder」說明結果掛在**分級授權**框架上**（**未讀，故不轉述其階梯分級**）。**⑥ ⭐ 「Live evaluation and cost controls」說明評測在真實調用中產生成本並被計量**。**⑦ ⭐ 「Research that shaped the approach」列出來源研究**。**⑧ ⭐ 含 CI 徽章與 CONTRIBUTING.md**，**工程規範程度高於同尺度項目**。
